title: The Receipt in the Attic
fact_notes: 架空の教材例・思考実験。実在の調査、統計、制度、実証結果ではない。登録台帳は制作来歴確認用。

sentences.en: In an imagined local archive, a historian examining documents donated by a family discovers a small collection of receipts from a shop that closed many decades earlier.
sentences.ja: 架空の地域資料館で家族から寄贈された文書を調べる歴史家は数十年前に閉店した店の領収書を見つける。

sentences.en: The documents initially appear less impressive than the photographs and letters in the same collection, since most contain only dates, descriptions of purchases, and short handwritten notes.
sentences.ja: ほとんどが日付、購入品の記述、短い手書きメモだけなので当初同じ収蔵品の写真や手紙より印象が薄い。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the historian becomes interested in the possibility of using these ordinary records to investigate aspects of daily economic life that were rarely described in more formal documents.
sentences.ja: それでも公式文書ではめったに記述されなかった日常経済生活の側面を普通の記録で調べる可能性に関心を持つ。

sentences.en: She begins by asking not simply what the receipts contain, but why this particular group of documents was kept when many others may have been discarded.
sentences.ja: 領収書の内容だけでなく多くが捨てられた可能性があるのになぜこの文書群が保存されたか問うことから始める。

sentences.en: A noticeable feature of the surviving records is that some customers appear repeatedly, whereas others are mentioned only on a single occasion despite apparently living in the same neighborhood.
sentences.ja: 残存記録の目立つ特徴は同じ近隣に住んでいたらしいのに何度も出る客と一度しか記載されない客がいることだ。

sentences.en: The historian considers whether this pattern reflects differences in purchasing habits or whether receipts were more likely to be preserved for transactions involving particular arrangements between the shopkeeper and customers.
sentences.ja: 購入習慣の差を反映するのか、店主と客の特定取り決めに関わる取引ほど領収書が残りやすかったのか考える。

sentences.en: A collection of documents produced for administrative purposes may represent the activities that required a written record more clearly than the activities that were completed without one.
sentences.ja: 事務目的の文書集は書面なしで完了した活動より記録が必要だった活動を明確に表す場合がある。

sentences.en: The surviving evidence consequently cannot be treated as a complete inventory of everything that took place in the shop during the period under investigation.
sentences.ja: したがって残った証拠を調査期間中の店の全出来事の完全な一覧と扱えない。

sentences.en: To investigate the significance of the receipts, the historian compares them with other fictional sources, including advertisements, a map of the surrounding streets, and descriptions of local transport arrangements.
sentences.ja: 領収書の意味を調べるため広告、周辺道路地図、地域交通の記述など架空の別資料と比較する。

sentences.en: These additional materials provide clues about which customers might have found the shop convenient, although they cannot establish the motivations behind every individual purchase.
sentences.ja: 追加資料はどの客が店を便利と感じた可能性があるかの手がかりになるが、個々の購入動機を全て確定できない。

sentences.en: She also distinguishes prices printed on general advertisements from the amounts recorded on particular receipts, since the two figures may reflect different conditions of sale.
sentences.ja: 広告の表示価格と個別領収書の額も区別する。二つの額は異なる販売条件を反映し得るからだ。

sentences.en: Rather than attempting to reconstruct a perfectly detailed picture of the neighborhood, she identifies relationships that can be supported by the available material and questions that remain unresolved.
sentences.ja: 近隣地域の完全詳細な像を再構成しようとせず資料で支持できる関係と未解決の問いを特定する。

sentences.en: When preparing an exhibition, the historian decides to show several receipts in their original form alongside explanations of the circumstances in which they might have been produced.
sentences.ja: 展示準備ではいくつかの領収書を原形で示し作成された可能性のある事情の説明を添えることにする。

sentences.en: She avoids selecting only unusual purchases, because such a display could give visitors a misleading impression of the transactions that characterized the shop's ordinary business.
sentences.ja: 珍しい購入だけ選ぶと店の日常業務を特徴づける取引について誤解を与え得るので避ける。

sentences.en: At the same time, she acknowledges that even a more varied selection cannot demonstrate how frequently any type of purchase actually occurred without more complete records.
sentences.ja: 同時に多様な選定でもより完全な記録なしには購入種類ごとの実際の頻度を示せないと認める。

sentences.en: The imagined archive does not contain genuine evidence about any particular economic period; it is a thought experiment about the relationship between surviving documents and the activities they represent.
sentences.ja: 架空資料館は特定経済時代の本物の証拠を持たず残存文書と表される活動の関係についての思考実験だ。

sentences.en: Historical research often requires attention to the ordinary procedures through which documents were produced, selected for preservation, and eventually made available to researchers.
sentences.ja: 歴史研究には文書が作られ保存対象に選ばれ最終的に研究者が利用するようになった日常手順への注意が必要なことが多い。

sentences.en: An absence from a historical collection may reflect the way an institution recorded information rather than the absence of the corresponding activity in people's lives.
sentences.ja: 歴史資料からの欠落は人々の生活で対応する活動がなかったことより組織の記録方法を反映し得る。

sentences.en: The historian's task involves recognizing that limitations on evidence can themselves provide information about what earlier communities considered necessary or valuable to record.
sentences.ja: 証拠の限界自体が過去の共同体が何を記録する必要や価値があると考えたかについて情報を与える場合があると認識することも歴史家の仕事だ。

sentences.en: In this example, the modest receipt becomes valuable not because it tells the entire story, but because it makes the researcher ask how a seemingly unremarkable fragment of the past came to survive.
sentences.ja: この例では簡素な領収書は全物語を語るからでなく一見平凡な過去の断片がなぜ残ったか研究者に問わせるから価値がある。

vocabulary.definition: made with a pen by a person
means of moving people or goods
actually what it claims to be

questions.prompt: What type of material attracts the historian's attention?
Why ask why the documents were kept?
options: Survival may reflect a selection process.
questions.explanation_ja: 保存過程に偏りがあり得る。

options: Some occur repeatedly while others occur once.

questions.prompt: Why might the pattern not reflect actual purchasing frequency?
options: All customers bought the same goods.
The shopkeeper recorded every transaction identically.
Some transactions may not have required retained records.
Advertisements, a map and transport descriptions.

questions.prompt: Why distinguish advertised prices from receipt amounts?
options: They may reflect different sale conditions.

questions.prompt: What selection does the historian avoid?
Why can even a varied selection be limited?
options: It proves every transaction was unusual.
It cannot establish actual frequency without fuller records.
Receipts alone explain an entire economy.
Absence of a record proves an activity never occurred.
Historical evidence must be interpreted in light of how records were created and preserved.
questions.explanation_ja: 記録生成と保存に注目。

grammar.focus: when many others may have been discarded
grammar.explanation_ja: may have been＋過去分詞は過去の可能性。

grammar.focus: although they cannot establish the motivations
not because it tells the entire story, but because
grammar.explanation_ja: not A but Bで理由を対比。

paraphrases.rewrite: She asks why these documents survived although others might have been thrown away.

paraphrases.source: A collection of documents produced for administrative purposes may represent the activities that required a written record more clearly than the activities that were completed without one.
paraphrases.rewrite: Administrative records may reveal recorded activities better than undocumented ones.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 記録される活動の偏り。

paraphrases.source: These additional materials provide clues about which customers might have found the shop convenient, although they cannot establish the motivations behind every individual purchase.
paraphrases.rewrite: Additional sources offer clues without proving each buyer's motive.

paraphrases.source: In this example, the modest receipt becomes valuable not because it tells the entire story, but because it makes the researcher ask how a seemingly unremarkable fragment of the past came to survive.
paraphrases.rewrite: The receipt matters because it prompts questions about survival, not because it provides a complete account.
